meta.title: How A Ten Dollar Coffee Turns Into A Thirty Five Dollar Bank Fee
meta.hook: Banks collect billions a year from a fee triggered by a balance that was only short by a few dollars.
meta.description: Overdraft fees are charged when an account balance goes negative, and banks have historically processed transactions in an order that can trigger several fees from a single low balance. It became a multi-billion dollar annual revenue line for the banking industry, though regulatory pressure and policy changes have cut that total roughly in half over the past few years. Educational content only, not financial advice.

scenes.narration: A ten dollar coffee can turn into a thirty five dollar bank fee.

visual.query: coffee cup receipt bank notification phone
visual.visual_intent: A coffee cup next to a phone showing a bank alert, warm cafe light, close shot

scenes.narration: It's called an overdraft fee. It triggers when your balance drops below zero, even by a few dollars.

visual.visual_intent: An account balance figure dropping below zero on a banking app screen, clean financial graphic

scenes.narration: Banks have historically processed several transactions in an order that can trigger more than one fee from a single low balance.

visual.visual_intent: Several small transaction icons stacking into a larger fee total, clean financial motion graphic
visual.decision_reason: documented CFPB finding on transaction ordering and multiple-fee triggers

scenes.narration: At its peak, this became a multi-billion dollar a year revenue line across the banking industry.

visual.query: tall financial bar chart billions dark
visual.visual_intent: A tall glowing bar on a dark financial chart, camera pushing in, dramatic scale
visual.decision_reason: CFPB has tracked overdraft/NSF revenue in the multi-billion dollar range annually

scenes.narration: Regulatory pressure and policy changes at several banks have cut that total roughly in half over the past few years.

visual.visual_intent: A declining bar chart trend over several bars, clean financial motion graphic
visual.decision_reason: CFPB reported overdraft/NSF revenue down more than 50% versus pre-pandemic; marked probable since the trend is ongoing and bank-specific

scenes.narration: The fee was never about the coffee. It was about the gap, and the order things got charged in. Follow for more.

visual.visual_intent: A bank statement with a fee line highlighted, close and deliberate, calm resolution shot
